other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India.
Must be pursuing or have completed an undergraduate/post‑graduation degree from a recognized university/institution (India or abroad) within six months of award.
Must have a minimum aggregate of 60% or CGPA 6.32/10 at all levels.
Eligible disciplines include optics, laser physics, space physics, geology, geophysics, atmospheric sciences, environmental sciences, meteorology, chemistry, ocean sciences and related subjects.
Preference is given to KVPY/DST INSPIRE fellows.
Should have reasonable proficiency in basic physics and mathematics.
Teachers must have an academic background in physics, applied physics, astronomy, space physics, geology or related fields.
Teachers must have at least five years of teaching experience at the graduate/post‑graduate level.
Teachers must hold a PhD degree.
Teachers must demonstrate research interest through publications or ongoing projects.
benefits_summary: Participants receive a certificate, limited paid accommodation (₹100 per day), mentorship and access to PRL facilities, but no stipend or financial assistance.
